font_size = 8

def newAxis(x, y, width, height, fig):
    ax = fig.add_axes([x, y, width, height])
    ax.set_yticks([])
    ax.set_xticks([])
    return ax

def showMatrix(  i , h, fig, data, l1s2  ):
    width, height = 0.05, 0.05 
    x = i * (width + 0.01) + (10 - l1s2 * (width + 0.01)) / 2
    y = - height - h
    ax = newAxis(x, y, width, height, fig)
    ax.imshow(data, cmap="coolwarm")  

def showLabel(h, label, fig):
    h += 0.16
    fig.text(5, - h + 0.03, label, fontdict={"size":font_size}, horizontalalignment='center', verticalalignment='center')
    return h

def showRowAndLabel( width, height, h, fig, data, label ):
    x, y = (10 - width)/2, -height - h
    ax = newAxis(x,y, width, height, fig)
    ax.imshow(data, cmap="coolwarm")    
    return showLabel(h, label, fig)

def getNormalisedFiltersBiases( ml ):
    filters, biases = ml.get_weights()   
    f_min, f_max = filters.min(), filters.max()
    filters = (filters - f_min) / (f_max - f_min)    
    return filters, biases

def showCNN(idx, model):
    layer_activations = [layer.output for layer in model.layers]
    model_activations = models.Model(inputs=model.input, outputs=layer_activations)    
    activations = model_activations.predict(X_test[idx].reshape((1, G, G, 1))) 
    h = 0  
    fig = plt.figure()
    for idx, ml in enumerate(model.layers):        
        layer = ml.output
        label = ml.name +' '+str(layer.shape)+' '+str(layer[1].shape)        
        if showInput and 'Input' in ml.name: 
            h = showRowAndLabel( 0.1, 0.1, h, fig, activations[idx][0,:,:,0], label )  
        if showDenseLayers and 'dense' in ml.name:  
            h = showRowAndLabel( 1, 0.1, h, fig, [activations[idx][0,:]], label )   
        if showFilterBiases and 'conv' in ml.name: 
            filters, biases = getNormalisedFiltersBiases(ml)
            h = showRowAndLabel( 4.2, 0.034, h, fig, [biases], label )      
        l1s2=layer[1].shape[-1]
        if (showPoolingLayers and 'pool' in ml.name or 
            showReluLayers and 're_lu' in ml.name and layer.shape.rank==4 or
            showConvolutions and 'conv' in ml.name): 
            for i in range(layer.shape[-1]):
                showMatrix( i, h, fig, activations[idx][0,:,:,i], l1s2 )     
            h = showLabel( h, label, fig )
        if showFilters and 'conv' in ml.name:
            filters, biases = getNormalisedFiltersBiases(ml)
            for x in range(filters.shape[2]):
                f = filters[:,:,x]     
                for i in range(f.shape[2]):   
                    showMatrix( i, h, fig, f[:,:,i], l1s2 )                   
                h += 0.05       
            h = showLabel( h, label, fig )
    clear_output(wait=True)
    plt.show()

class MyLogger(keras.callbacks.Callback):
    def on_train_begin(self,logs={}):
        self.losses = []
        self.accuracies = []
        self.sampling=100
        self.cnt=0

    def on_batch_end(self, batch, logs={}):
        self.losses.append(logs.get('loss'))
        self.accuracies.append(logs.get('accuracy'))

    def on_batch_begin(self, epoch, logs=None):
        sample = randint(1, 100)
        self.cnt +=1
        if True and self.cnt % self.sampling == 0:
            showCNN(sample, self.model)


    model = newModel()
logs = MyLogger()
callbacks = [logs]
